title: Late-1970s research into ELF and frequency weapons, with Valerie involved

tellings.quote: So that was kind of like the wild west in the in the late '70s there of like I think people trying to figure out what this is, what can be done with it. And he was just like in in the middle of that.

plain: In the late 1970s, people were experimenting with extremely low frequency radio waves, known as ELF, and with weapons based on frequencies, trying to work out what such waves could do, and the scientist at the center of that episode was in the middle of it. The researcher Greg Malatzi describes this period as a "wild west" without naming a source, and ties it to a person he names only as Valerie; it matters because it would put that scientist inside early secret work on energy weapons.
